NIGHT.policy: Plutus V3 (8.7 KB); minted once, 24B on 2025-11-25. Whether it can mint again is not established without auditing the script.

exclusions.label: community burn address (always-fail script)
exclusions.evidence: 46-byte Plutus V2 script; aiken uplc decode: ifThenElse(False, (), error) for any datum/redeemer/context.

exclusions.label: Reserve (block-producer rewards)
exclusions.evidence: Exactly 6,000,000,000 in one UTxO = published Reserve 6B. Split 2026-03-13 from genesis output that held Reserve+Treasury+L&F (7,392,600,599 = 6B + 1.141B + 0.252B).

exclusions.label: Script beside the Reserve (probable on-chain Treasury)
exclusions.evidence: Exactly 1,200,000,000 in one UTxO, same 1374-byte script template as the Reserve, split from the same genesis output. Published Treasury is 1.141B (1.2B before revision): identity not proven, lock is.

exclusions.label: Community allocation not yet claimed
exclusions.evidence: Received 4,547,399,400 at genesis = Glacier Drop 3.547B + Scavenger Mine 1B; fans out to per-recipient thaw schedules.

exclusions.label: Claimed, waiting in thaw schedules
exclusions.evidence: ~69k per-recipient UTxOs; thaw runs 2025-12-10 to 2026-12-04, then a 90-day grace period (midnight.network redemption guide). Part of it is already unlockable, so this exclusion is conservative.

NIGHT.unresolved: Midnight Foundation 8.4B and TGE 3.66B went to ~20 key wallets at genesis (sum matches 12.06B); key wallets can trade, so they stay in.
NIGHT.unresolved_say: That is an upper bound. The Midnight Foundation's and launch allocations sit in ordinary wallets, and nothing on the chain stops them trading, so they are counted in

MIN.policy: a single key signature, no time limit: more MIN can be minted or burned by whoever holds that key. Minted 5B (2021-22); 2B burned by negative mint on 2024-01-15 (max supply cut 5B -> 3B).
